modelDescription: Fiocchi continues its long standing tradition of delivering the highest quality, most diverse product offering to the American Skeet shooter. The Shooting Dynamics shotshell load delivers performance, value, and results. It uses top quality components such as one-piece shot cups, with cushioned wads propelled by clean burning powders, topped off by Fiocchi primer.
